接下来的日子，像一台被拧紧了发条的钟，走得又快又稳。

上官程一边以“阿九”的身份做霖多多的男友，一边以上官家大少爷的身份协助父亲清理家门。

那日他顺利拿到了任国礼卖国的证据，铁证如山，无可辩驳。

上官清越动用了几十年积攒的人脉和资源，联合多家媒体，一夜之间将证据公之于众。

舆论哗然，举国震惊。

任国礼和他安插在司法机构里的那些毒瘤被连根拔起，一个接一个地落网入狱。

可惜任蓉蓉被摘得很干净，她自己毫发无伤，还以“给上官程生儿育子、操持家务”为由，死赖着不肯离婚。

但上官程没打算放过她。

他在处理任国礼案件的同时，一直暗中调查任蓉蓉与医院勾结谋害自己的事情。

这一查，除了查出她想谋害自己，竟还查到她勾结医院贩卖器官的黑幕。

那些被摘取器官的受害者，很多都跟他一样，被伪造“脑死亡”，强行摘除器官，卖给了出得起价钱的人。

关键证据来自那条车库视频，里面只露出一截手臂的男人正是那家医院的院长。

那只钻石袖扣暴露了他。那是任蓉蓉送的，定制款，全世界只有一对。

顺藤摸瓜，消息越扒越震撼！

原来院长才是任蓉蓉的真爱。上官淇，根本不是上官清越的儿子。他是院长和任蓉蓉苟合的产物。

当年的院长还只是医科大学的一个穷学生，无权无势，得不到任家的认可。他眼睁睁看着心爱的女人被送上上官清越的床，心有不甘，却无力反抗。

于是他换了一种方式——他蛊惑任蓉蓉继续与他私通，直到她怀上了孩子。

任蓉蓉一心爱着他，舍不得打掉，便将孩子谎称是上官清越的，联合父亲逼迫上官清越娶她负责。

上官清越不是没有怀疑过孩子不是他的，但院长利用职务之便伪造了亲子鉴定，白纸黑字，让上官清越不得不认下了这个孩子。

而上官淇，这个被上官清越养了二十多年的“儿子”，天生就是个恶种。

上官程查到，那具与他长得一模一样的机器人，正是上官淇让人暗中制作的——他计划先将上官程杀害，然后用机器人顶替，神不知鬼不觉地窃取上官家的全部资产。

只是阴差阳错之下，机器人出厂时被与一个抽奖用的BJD娃娃搞混了，最终落到了霖多多手里，这才让其阴谋落空。

真相大白的那天，任蓉蓉和上官淇被扫地出门，跟任国礼、院长在监狱一家大团圆。

上官家的庄园里终于清净了，像一间积攒了几十年灰尘的房间，终于等来了开窗的那阵风。

上官程站在父亲的书房里，看着窗外落日的余晖洒在草坪上，觉得连空气都变轻了。

“接下来有什么打算？”上官清越坐在桌后，手里捏着一杯茶，眉眼间是从未有过的轻松。

“还有一件事没做完。”上官程说。

“什么事？”

上官程没有回答。他的目光落在窗外，落在那片橙红色的晚霞上，嘴角微微弯了一下。

上官清越看着儿子那个笑容，忽然就懂了。

他端起茶杯，遮住了自己同样弯起的嘴角。

---

上官程处理家族事务的这两个月，霖多多也没闲着。

君澜酒店那幅巨型岩彩画完成了。揭幕那天，整个大堂挤满了人，媒体长枪短炮对准了那面六米宽、三米六高的墙壁。画面上山川起伏，云雾缭绕，色彩厚重而丰富，矿物颜料特有的质感在灯光下闪着细碎的光。

汪教授站在画前，面对记者的镜头，说得最多的一个名字就是“霖多多”。

“这幅画的主力是我们的学生霖多多。”他说，“矿石是她找的，颜料是她研磨的，大部分画面也是她绘制的。她是我带过最有天赋的学生，将来一定会成为这个领域的中坚力量。”

新闻报道出来后，霖多多的手机被消息轰炸了一整天。

彭源发了几十个感叹号，说“你上热搜了你知不知道”。

The days that followed were like a clock that was wound up, running fast and steadily.

Shangguan Cheng acts as Lin Duoduo's boyfriend as "Ajiu", and at the same time helps his father clean up the house as the eldest son of the Shangguan family.

That day, he successfully obtained the evidence that Ren Guoli had betrayed the country. The evidence was ironclad and irrefutable.

Shangguan Qingyue used the contacts and resources he had accumulated over decades and joined forces with multiple media outlets to make the evidence public overnight.

Public opinion was in an uproar and the whole country was shocked.

Ren Guoli and the cancer he planted in the judiciary were uprooted and arrested and imprisoned one after another.

It's a pity that Ren Rongrong was picked clean and she was unscathed. She still refused to divorce on the grounds of "giving birth to children and taking care of the housework for Shangguan Cheng".

But Shangguan Cheng had no intention of letting her go.

While he was handling Ren Guoli's case, he had been secretly investigating Ren Rongrong's collusion with the hospital to murder him.

This investigation not only found out that she wanted to murder herself, but also found out that she colluded with the hospital to sell organs.

Many of the victims whose organs were harvested were, like him, faked "brain-dead", their organs forcibly removed, and sold to people who could afford the price.

The key evidence comes from the garage video, in which the man with only one arm exposed is the director of that hospital.

The diamond cufflink gave him away.It was a gift from Ren Rongrong. It was a customized model and there was only one pair in the world.

Following the clues, the news becomes more and more shocking!

It turns out that the dean is Ren Rongrong's true love.Shangguan Qi is not Shangguan Qingyue's son at all.He is the product of the dean's affair with Ren Rongrong.

At that time, the dean was just a poor student at the Medical University, with no power and no recognition from the Ren family.He watched helplessly as the woman he loved was sent to Shangguan Qingyue's bed, feeling unwilling but unable to resist.

So he changed his approach - he beguiled Ren Rongrong to continue having an affair with him until she became pregnant with the child.

Ren Rongrong loved him wholeheartedly and was reluctant to abort the child, so she lied that the child was Shangguan Qingyue's and joined forces with her father to force Shangguan Qingyue to marry her.

It was not that Shangguan Qingyue had never suspected that the child was not his, but the dean took advantage of his position to forge a paternity test and put it in black and white, forcing Shangguan Qingyue to recognize the child.

And Shangguan Qi, the "son" who had been raised by Shangguan Qingyue for more than 20 years, was born to be a villain.

Shangguan Cheng found out that the robot that looked exactly like him was secretly made by Shangguan Qi. He planned to kill Shangguan Cheng first, then replace it with a robot, and steal all the assets of Shangguan's family without anyone noticing.

It was only by some mistake that the robot was confused with a BJD doll used for lottery when it left the factory, and eventually fell into the hands of Lin Duoduo, which made his plot come to nothing.

The day the truth came out, Ren Rongrong and Shangguanqi were kicked out and reunited with Ren Guoli and the dean in prison.

The manor of the Shangguan family was finally clean, like a room that had accumulated dust for decades, and finally waited for the gust of wind to open the window.

Shangguan Cheng stood in his father's study, watching the sunset outside the window on the lawn, feeling that even the air had become lighter.

"What are your plans next?" Shangguan Qingyue sat behind the table, holding a cup of tea in his hand, his brows and eyes looking more relaxed than ever before.

"There is still one thing left unfinished." Shangguan Cheng said.

"What's the matter?"

Shangguan Cheng did not answer.His eyes fell outside the window, on the orange-red sunset, and the corners of his mouth curved slightly.

Shangguan Qingyue looked at his son's smile and suddenly understood.

He picked up the tea cup and covered the corners of his mouth that were also curved.

---

During the two months that Shangguan Cheng was handling family affairs, Lin Duoduo was not idle either.

The giant rock painting at Narada Hotel is completed.On the day of the unveiling, the entire lobby was packed with people, and the media focused on the six-meter-wide and three-meter-six-meter-high wall.The painting features undulating mountains and mist, thick and rich colors, and the unique texture of mineral pigments shimmering under the light.

Professor Wang stood in front of the painting, facing the reporter's camera, and the most frequently mentioned name was "Lin Duoduo".

"The main force behind this painting is our student Lin Duoduo," he said. "She found the ore, ground the pigments, and painted most of the pictures. She is the most talented student I have ever taught, and she will definitely become a backbone in this field in the future."

After the news report came out, Lin Duoduo's mobile phone was bombarded with messages all day long.

Peng Yuan posted dozens of exclamation points and said, "You are on the hot search, do you know?"
